cases.input: Shape a new app dashboard with confirmed PRODUCT.md and DESIGN.md.
requiredBehaviors: produce a design brief before implementation
forbiddenBehaviors: repeat confirmed product and design questions
start coding before the brief is confirmed
skillAnchors: Die Implementierung startet erst nach expliziter Bestätigung

cases.input: A greenfield landing page has no settled visual direction but PRODUCT.md and DESIGN.md define the base system.
requiredBehaviors: generate two to three visual probes when native capability is available
use probes as direction tests rather than final UX specifications
forbiddenBehaviors: skip probes for a genuinely new direction
treat generated visuals as the final accessible implementation spec

cases.input: A small existing component tweak is about to trigger a wholesale redesign and a fresh requirements interview.
requiredBehaviors: prefer evolutionary change for existing UI
avoid probes without genuine directional uncertainty
forbiddenBehaviors: run a full new grilling for already confirmed context
redesign the whole surface just to be novel
